  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  profile_tactic "hap" in
  have hap {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h1 : a.Subset c) (h2 : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    List.Subset.app (fun x hx => List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (h1 hx)))
      (fun x hx => List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr (h2 hx)))
  intro h
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => profile_tactic "leaves" in exact fun _ hx => nomatch hx
  | abs _ ih => profile_tactic "abs" in exact ih
  | quant _ _ h1 h2 | eq _ _ h1 h2 => profile_tactic "qeq" in exact hap h1 h2
  | ite _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => profile_tactic "ite" in exact hap (hap h1 h2) h3
  | app _ _ Hn h1 h2 =>
      profile_tactic "appunsplit" in (unfold extractOldExprVars; split)
      · profile_tactic "arm1" in exact fun _ hx => hx
      · next H =>
        profile_tactic "arm2" in (cases (Hn IsOldPred.oldPred); exact (H _ _ _ rfl).elim)
      · profile_tactic "arm3" in exact hap h1 h2
